value.rationale: The first four natural unresolved dyadic checkpoints following the known exact prefix length 64 now have provably sharp values, replacing broad intervals and displaying a genuine plateau (256 to 512) followed by a jump (1024). Explicit small rational duals are more than a recomputation of prior tables and provide a constructive lower-bound technique in a named automatic-word open profile. The limited finite scope is stated and no all-length novelty is claimed.
